description: This file provides cache management functions for a Linux-based embedded system, specifically focusing on LZMA compressed kernel loading for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes routines to flush the CPU cache over a specified memory range, with specific cache operations implemented via inline assembly.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes a range of memory addresses from CPU cache, using architecture-specific cache operations to ensure data consistency.
